Data is a canonical empty initial/frozen Cell scope bound to full identity and retained writer proof; the data contains no Root owner.
Root's trusted typed profile is the authorization input. The actual daemon profile must equal it during both original joined messages.

Requires actual same original A selection/manifest, drained journal, full agent/cell/run/principal, published CURRENT, retained use and physical observation around durable once-claim.
InputsOpened is data; OriginalAPrepared carries the actual Prepared Arc and derived profile; OriginalSelectionObserved carries only a digest, insufficient to recreate target/selection owners.
Only actual completed Outcome, prepare_learning, retained source and task-local drain precede the Prepared event; original retirement begins immediately afterward.
Serializes actual supplied CellGenerationObserverConfigV1 and independent SignedArtifactSelectionV1; creates neither signature nor owner.
Root-fixed paths/trust and actual read-view locate original selected files; verifies actual retained current, withdrawal floor and independent selection. Peer JSON supplies no paths.
The actual host owns target File, witness, generation config and bound; a target configuration or digest alone is not this owner.

Exact SO_PEERCRED UID/PID plus actual held pidfd. First-byte idle waits only to original phase end; the original per-frame deadline is then shared by remaining frame, handler and ACK. Storage is not forcibly cancelled and overdue ACK is denied.
Inherited socketpair SO_PEERCRED represents creator Root, not the later non-Root daemon. No reverse use as current-daemon authentication; no SCM_CREDENTIALS mechanism was inferred.

Actual A task, independent Outcome, native Prepared/retained source and task-local drain produce OriginalAPrepared. Root authorization material must separately be ready; a missing file is not waited for inside the frame.
Sequence 2 and its eventual actual ACK run concurrently with actual A retirement/join and scoped offer receive. Waiting on the ACK must not block those owners.
Actual Training/B/Decision/Artifact/Selection and actual C target resources precede sequence 3. Only after actual Current ACK may ordinary C publication request proceed.
After the three ACKs both sides retain this original purpose lane until common closure. EOF, Gate.close, pending=0 and this protocol's return are not final completion or physical join.
